row.title: An empty reading is unmeasured, never zero
row.body: Red-team pass 2026-11-25: the cost probe recorded d1: [] for weeks because run() read data/cost-thresholds.json, which never existed, and foundation/cost.py scored probe rows as 0 while the measured Workers AI use was 0.805 of the free budget (source: ops/cost.jsonl, 2026-11-24 row); the platform feed had empty texts and stopped updating on 2026-11-17 because site/feed-data.js was regenerated but never committed. Detectors cost-runaway, d1-growth, credential-expiry and content-drift now fail on these.
